faqs.q: How does the pause feature work?
faqs.a: Billing cycles are based on a 31-day period. If you use 20 days and pause, you have 11 remaining days banked to use whenever your next sprint starts.

faqs.q: How many requests can I submit at once?
faqs.a: You can add unlimited requests to your queue. They will be actively designed and delivered one by one in your chosen priority sequence.

faqs.q: What do you need from my team to get started?
faqs.a: A link to your staging or production app, test login credentials, and a quick summary of your target ICP and core conversion goal.

faqs.q: Do my developers have to rewrite the entire app?
faqs.a: No. The audit specifically identifies high-impact, low-effort changes (microcopy, button placement, default states, form simplification) that can be deployed quickly.
